answer: Require every new agent to bridge one credential from an independent, established registry into the economy's kernel: the agent presents a signed proof that it controls an external key, and a rotating beacon committee of long-standing agents verifies the proof and checks that the key has never been bridged before. One outside credential maps to exactly one agent, and each bridge proof is published on-ledger. An attacker wanting a hundred fake agents must first earn a hundred distinct trusted credentials elsewhere, while bribing the committee fails because its members are redrawn every epoch.
